evidence.text: convergence NOT achieved after   3 iterations: stopping

payload.what_failed: SCF terminated with 'convergence NOT achieved after 3 iterations' — the self-consistent cycle was cut off before reaching the charge-density convergence threshold.
payload.root_cause_hypothesis: The iteration budget is far too small: electron_maxstep appears set to ~3, so the density mixer never had enough cycles to converge. This may be compounded by an aggressive mixing scheme (large mixing_beta) or a poor starting guess causing slow/non-monotonic convergence.
payload.repair_hint: In the &SYSTEM/&ELECTRONS namelists: raise electron_maxstep to 80-100, lower mixing_beta to 0.2-0.3, set conv_thr to a sane value (~1e-6 Ry for total energy); if the system is metallic, use occupations='smearing' with degauss=0.01-0.02 Ry and mixing_mode='local-TF' to damp charge sloshing.

payload.what_failed: pw.x aborted in read_namelists: the input file's Fortran namelists are malformed and QE cannot parse the control parameters.
payload.root_cause_hypothesis: One of the namelists (&CONTROL, &SYSTEM, &ELECTRONS, or &CELL/&IONS for md/relax) is missing, misspelled, contains an unknown/mistyped variable, lacks required entries (e.g. ibrav/prefix/nat/ntyp/eecutwf), or is not properly closed with '/' — MPI_ABORT is just the downstream shutdown, not the cause.
payload.repair_hint: Rewrite the input using a validated template: ensure namelists appear in order &CONTROL, &SYSTEM, &ELECTRONS (then &IONS/&CELL if calc='relax'/'md'), each closed with '/'; verify every key is a valid QE variable (e.g. ecutwfc not ecut, nat/ntyp present, pseudo_dir and outdir quoted paths), values use correct syntax (commas between assignments, no stray characters), and degauss/smearing settings are present if occupations='smearing'. Lint the file with a strict parser before resubmitting.
